subject: gk
question:
Consider the following statements and select the correct option.

A : All the objects must change from solids into liquids before changing into gases.

B : Evaporation is the process by which solids can change into gases.

options.text: A is false, but B is true
Both A and B are true
Both A and B are false
A is true, but B is false

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and B are false**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Explanation of Statement A:**
 
• Statement A claims that **all objects must change from solids into liquids before changing into gases**, which is **incorrect**.
 
• This process is known as **melting** (solid to liquid) followed by **vaporization** (liquid to gas), but it is not mandatory for all substances.
 
• Some substances can directly change from a solid to a gas through a process called **sublimation**, bypassing the liquid phase.
 
• Examples of substances that undergo sublimation include **dry ice (solid CO₂)** and **camphor**.
 
• Sublimation occurs under specific temperature and pressure conditions, depending on the substance.
